name: worker-pool
description: Pool workers the core delegates to. No tools; manifest present to DECLARE config per this convention: WORKER_POOL_IDENTITY_ON_CREATE (on by default) makes create_worker start the new worker's own agent identity (the owner approves a link in their DM; set 0 or pass --no-identity to skip). WORKER_POOL_SSPACE_HANDOFF (off by default) sends pool_ask from the core to a worker that has its own enabled agent identity as one message in a room both agents are in instead of through deliveries/<worker>/; the worker's threaded reply arrives as a new task. WORKER_POOL_DELIVERY_TTL_S (14400) is how long a delivery sentinel's lease lets the worker reply as the core; WORKER_POOL_DELIVERY_EXPIRY (warn) logs a lapsed or missing lease, enforce refuses that reply.
